paper-invented: Court official Cai Lun is credited with refining papermaking from bark, hemp and rags.
sakoku-japan-closes-to-the-world: For two centuries only Dutch and Chinese traders may trade, the Dutch confined to the island of Dejima in Nagasaki.
haitian-revolution: Enslaved Africans overthrow French rule and found the first state born from a successful slave revolt.
october-revolution: Lenin's Bolsheviks seize power in Petrograd (25 October in the old Russian calendar).
valdivia-earthquake: Magnitude 9.5, the most powerful earthquake ever recorded.
rwandan-genocide: In about 100 days, Hutu extremists murder an estimated 500,000–800,000 people, most of them Tutsi.
